verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions linking accounts via Connect, webhooks and data refresh. Nothing documents connection-error or expired/revoked statuses, or a re-authentication or update flow that repairs an existing link without starting over. Account-linking repair is a fair question for an open-banking aggregator, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an ops lead, broken connections are repairable — expired or revoked links surface as documented statuses, and users can re-authenticate in an update flow without starting over
